name: Lucilla
source:
The proprietor of the "Enfukurou" brothel in the entertainment district in West Grasesta, the half-elf half-succubus has worked her way up the ranks and her business has flourished under her astute management. 

[Spoiler] Lucilla is well aware of the importance of her establishment in keeping the peace between the slave warriors as they are given a means of spending their currency to satisfy their sexual desires. Ladies who are not suited for combat can also find a decent living under her establishment. 

Lucilla remembers living conditions prior to Legi's reforms and is thankful the situation when Judar arrives is less oppressive than it used to be. When Legi makes his move, she is conflicted as she understands why many would want to join the ranks of the Rinshi while others like herself reject their advances.

Lucilla welcomes any and all applicants to her business regardless of whether they are angel, harpy or demon. She will happily purchase workers from willing traders, as a reward the trader is given the privilege of spending the first night with her new worker at no additional charge. [/Spoiler]
